newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers firm, Mediterranean dips, market thin.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers firm, Mediterranean dips, market thin.

text.p: ARA bunkers firmed slightly on Monday, while prices in the Mediterranean dipped, in an all-round thin market, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST rose to around $115 fob as barges felt the effect of ice-locked waterways and a return to normal of refinery operations in Rotterdam.
On Friday, one major had difficulties with its flexi-coker, making it a large seller of high sulphur fuel oil, but the company said the refinery was running fine on Monday.
Rotterdam stayed open and reachable despite the deep freeze, but links with Amsterdam and Antwerp were frozen up.
"It could be the end of the week before the problems are past," one supplier said.
Total ARA demand was very slight with little more than a few enquiries.
Hamburg bunkers followed ARA's lead, prices rising by about $1 a tonne to around $128 fob for 380 CST.
Mediterranean prices were mostly about $1 weaker than at Friday's close. Demand was slight in all ports.
Canary Islands supply was limited, but a cargo was expected to relieve the shortage by Wednesday.
